name: Searing Shield (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Spell shield arcana

Benefit: When she activates her spell shield and an opponent attacks her and misses her newly improved Armor Class but would hit the Armor Class total she had before applying the shield’s benefits, the foe suffers 2d6 points of fire damage. In this case, her foe strikes her shield’s fiery, burning aura.
